name: Söyembikä of Kazan
contribution: A Nogai ruler, xanbikä. She served as regent of Kazan during the minority of her son from 1549 until 1551.

checks.lead: Söyembikä (also spelled Söyenbikä, Sujumbike, pronounced [sœˌjœmbiˈkæ]; Cyrillic: Сөембикә) (1516 – after 1553) was a Nogai ruler, xanbikä. She served as regent of Kazan during the minority of her son from 1549 until 1551.
